title: Incorrect auto-completion and tooltip for named lambda
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.dev [220b0b2f7], 4.6.stable, 4.4.1.stable.

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop - Intel i7-12700H (20 threads)

### Issue description

First, named lambda should not show the auto-complete menu for function names, because a named lambda cannot be called by its name, and also its name will not shadow any global or local methods.

Second, this causes the tooltip to show up (with incorrect info) when hovering the cursor over the first character of the lambda's name.

The cause seems to be that, when `GDScriptLanguage::lookup_code()` handles a named lambda declaration, the `context.type` is set to `COMPLETION_IDENTIFIER` instead of `COMPLETION_NONE`.

Discovered this issue when working on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106987, but I forgot to report it back then.

### Steps to reproduce

--- Method 1 ---
Type the following code (slowly) in the GDScript editor:
```gdscript
var named_lambda_1 = func log():
    return null
```
While typing `func l`, the auto-complete menu will pop up.

--- Method 2 ---
Add a `print_line(context.type)` after this line:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/847d68431451a8988ab9385bf617a52ae0f43d11/modules/gdscript/gdscript_editor.cpp#L4418

Then, recompile the Godot editor, open the GDScript editor, and paste in this code:
```gdscript
var named_lambda_1 = func get():
    return null
```

Then, hover the mouse cursor over the first letter `g` of `get`. A tooltip will pop up, and the `print_line()` prints the integer value of `GDScriptParser::COMPLETION_IDENTIFIER`.
